message:
Plain words: blind driving means the operators see only what the robot sees, so the digging end stays the leading end and the dump end stays the trailing end. This follows the sealed base station pattern where the team teleoperates the rover from a sealed base station and can only see through the onboard cameras and sensors from the Perseus: Building a Lunar Rover with QUT ROAR (E26), implemented as forward drive camera plus downward dig camera plus mast camera shown in the blind-operation layout sketch (E34).

Plain words: if the radio link dies the robot must stop itself within a shoe length, not coast. This follows the heartbeat signal ensures a constant link pattern from the BWI Eagle - E-Stop (E27) and the enter emergency landing mode on loss of communication rule from the Failsafe; Pilot Guideline - Flyability ELIOS User Manual (E30). With speed capped at 0.500 m/s and 0.500 s timeout, coast plus brake distance is 0.308 m stopping in 0.750 s from the link-loss watchdog stop distance vs latency at 0.5 m/s simulation (E32), near the 62.5 mm brake-only distance from the stowed envelope sum, ground pressure, tip-over and stopping check (E23); everyday scale says this is gentle, well under 1 g. Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU, meaning motion sensor for tilt and turn) plus wheel odometry holds heading during the stop.

Plain words: wheels plus IMU alone wander off course on loose soil, so the bin carries a visual marker to reset position. This follows the fuse wheel odometry and IMU to improve localization precision because skid steering must skid to turn rule from the Absolute and relative localization (E28) and the maximum horizontal position drifts are all less than 2 percent finding from the A Comparison of Three Measurement Models for the Wheel-Mounted MEMS IMU-Based Dead Reckoning System (E31). Dead reckoning reaches 0.800 m along plus 1.40 m sideways at 40.0 m, but resetting on the bin fiducial every 5.00 m bounds error to about 0.100 to 0.150 m from the blind localization drift growth odometry plus IMU without external fix simulation (E33), which is smaller than the robot and enough to align the pour.

Not ready, because Power Structure and Integration Lead must still confirm camera and compute power in the 60 kg sum and the fiducial-visibility bench test is still open.
